role: independent referee recomputation, not a lifecycle or publication operation
question: Do freshly reconstructed addressed NAE patterns reproduce the returning verdicts, sampled patterns, activity classes and joining counts?
observables: level verdict with directly checked assignment or independently checked DRUP proof
level knot count and SHA-1 pattern fingerprint
exact relative activity class and degree
scope and denominator of prose claims
selection: seven eventually parity-alternating returns first; other returns in increasing total recorded knot count; deterministic stratified pattern samples; separate class-balanced activity sample
controls: letter-by-letter action against inductive array action
exhaustive Fano unsatisfiability against DRUP proof
false empty clause and truncated proof rejection
watched propagation against independent plain propagation
decision: Report every mismatch or uncertified verdict explicitly. Finite agreement does not prove an all-level survival or alternation claim.
resource_budget: at most 3 computation processes, 10 GB total, commands about 15 minutes maximum, whole task about 60 minutes, CPU only, no network
nonclaims: no inference beyond level 12 from finite verdicts
activity is an upper bound on joining, not a lower bound
no theorem of native emergence or complexity separation
